sections.heading: What storm damage means
sections.body: Storm means violent wind, including wind gusts recorded as damaging, and rain, hail, snow or sleet accompanying that wind. Damage caused by water entering the home as a direct result of storm damage to the building is included. A gradual leak, damp or rising ground water is not storm damage.

sections.heading: Your home
sections.body: We cover sudden and accidental loss or damage to your home caused by a storm, up to the dwelling sum insured shown on your policy schedule. Your home includes the dwelling, permanent fixtures, garages and outbuildings on the same site.

sections.heading: Fences, gates and retaining walls
sections.body: We cover storm damage to fences, gates and retaining walls on your site. Cover for these items may be limited to the amount shown in your schedule.

sections.heading: Contents damaged by storm
sections.body: We cover contents inside your home that are damaged as a direct consequence of storm damage to the building, up to the contents sum insured.

sections.heading: Excess
sections.body: An excess applies to each claim. Where a storm excess is shown on your schedule, it applies instead of the standard excess for storm claims. The excess is deducted from the amount we pay.

sections.heading: Temporary accommodation
sections.body: If your home cannot reasonably be lived in because of damage we cover, and temporary accommodation is shown on your schedule, we will contribute to reasonable temporary accommodation costs.

sections.heading: Exclusion - maintenance and gradual deterioration
sections.body: We do not cover loss or damage caused by or resulting from lack of maintenance, gradual deterioration, wear and tear, rust, rot, mould or mildew, or anything that happens gradually over time, even if a storm made the damage apparent.

sections.heading: Exclusion - pre-existing condition of roofing and cladding
sections.body: We do not cover loss or damage to roofing, guttering or cladding that was already in a deteriorated, rusted, rotten or unrepaired condition before the storm, or damage that results from that condition.

sections.heading: Exclusion - unoccupied or unsecured home
sections.body: We do not cover storm damage where the home was left unsecured, or where openings were left unprotected after earlier damage was known about.

sections.heading: Condition - telling us about a claim
sections.body: You must tell us about loss or damage as soon as reasonably possible after it happens, and give us the information we reasonably need to deal with the claim.

sections.heading: Condition - keeping your home in repair
sections.body: You must keep your home in a reasonable state of repair and take reasonable care to prevent loss or damage.

sections.heading: Condition - preventing further damage
sections.body: After loss or damage you must take reasonable steps to prevent further damage, including emergency make-safe work. We will contribute to the reasonable cost of that work where the claim is accepted.
